title: Version 1.23.0
body:
Version 1.23.0

July 12th, 2023

Added:

  • Added wooden crates! They have three different sizes, small, medium, and large! Can be purchased at the junkyard

Changes:

  • Collision has been removed from wheel covers on both flatbed trailers
  • Reverted physics back to the legacy system, as improvements were minimal, and issues were abundant
  • Maximum Garage door width increased to 21 as per request

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed Oakmobiles being able to be dragged by any player
